product_metadata.title: HeQiao Digital Clock with Calendar & Temperature, Large LCD Screen Alarm Clock with Extra Large Digits, Easy to Read and Set, Perfect for Seniors (Black w/Silver)
features: Day digital clock A large LCD screen and clear surface lens give you a good view. Bold numbers could be easy-to-read from anywhere in the room.
Digital alarm clock Showing the Time (12/24hr), Date, Weekday and indoor Temperature (℃/℉) ) on one large screen, and features a loud alarm with a snooze function.
Silent sweeping movement, mute movement, the silent clock give you a quiet night.
Table standing with its fold-out stand or wall-mounted to save space.
Battery-powered (requires 2 AA, not included). Insert 2 fresh, new alkaline batteries and set your time & date.
